title: As enterprises confront AI agent sprawl, xpander wants them to own their own control and context layer
summary: OpenAI's Frontier platform provides shared enterprise context, permissions, agent execution and management, while Google's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform combines managed runtime infrastructure with agent identity, centralized governance, memory, tracing and policy enforcement around agent-to-agent and agent-to-tool interactions.
